School & learning

vocabulary noun

also vocab, words, learn vocabulary

classical

Ter. Eun. 2.2.33: philosophōrum habent disciplīnae ex ipsīs vocābula (Lewis & Short)
Traupman 25, 32: vocābula Latīna ēdidicī, I memorized the Latin vocabulary
Traupman 402

vocābula, vocābulōrum n.

plural of vocābulum · Declension on Wiktionary

words, vocabulary

Vocābulum is a name or word for a thing.

Examples

  • cōpia verbōrum

    vocabulary, a stock of wordsCic. de Or. 3.125: rērum cōpia verbōrum cōpiam gignit (Lewis & Short s.v. cōpia); Traupman 402

See also word, learn by heart.
